summary.intent: Complete the post-research phase of a GSD workflow for IPFS/IPNS data integrity fixes, running validation gates and creating the VALIDATION.md planning artifact.
summary.outcome: VALIDATION.md was created and committed; gates confirmed no UI spec needed (API+SDK only) and no schema migrations required; security enforcement (ASVS L1) was noted for the planner.

repo: The project uses a GSD workflow with structured planning phases under .planning/phases/<phase-name>/
Post-research gates include: Nyquist validation strategy, UI safety gate, security gate (ASVS L1), and schema-push detection
UI safety gate skips UI-SPEC generation for API+SDK-only changes
Schema-push detection checks for TypeORM entity/migration changes, not service/processor/DTO/script changes
The researcher step produces a 50-RESEARCH.md with findings, confidence levels, and pinned line numbers
workflow: GSD phases run validation gates in parallel after research completes
VALIDATION.md is generated from a template at .claude/gsd-core/templates/VALIDATION.md with frontmatter filled per workflow
API surface regeneration (intel gate) follows VALIDATION.md creation and commit

open_items: Security enforcement (ASVS L1, block on high) still needs to be applied during implementation — flagged for the planner but not yet acted on
